notes:
Lead origin: self-serve signup from Product Hunt listing (2026-02-09).

Background:
- B2B SaaS (customer success platform) building an in-app, agent-like chat widget for end-user support and workflow triage.
- Prototype already running with a lightweight rule-based fallback; wants to replace with LLM streaming for better UX.
- CTO/founder: small eng team (front-end heavy), cares about typing latency and token cost. Quote from call: \"Users abandon the chat if responses lag — need ~sub-200ms feel for short replies.\"

Technical requirements and constraints (from discovery):
- Primary workload: low-latency streaming responses for short, structured replies (support replies, help tips, link suggestions).
- Latency targets: p50 < 200ms for short replies (~40-120 tokens), p99 < 800ms when feasible.
- Throughput: expected concurrent users 50-200 during peak; initial QPS target ~15-30.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; prefers hosted pay-as-you-go with clear per-token estimates.
- Model preferences: open models preferred (cost & licensing), but will consider Redwood-curated options if latency/cost tradeoffs are clear.
- Features wanted: streaming SSE for token-by-token render, function/tool-calling for internal KB lookups, prefix caching to reuse common prompts.
- Security: SSO for admin, audit logs, KMS integration for API keys, data retention controls. No on-prem required for now.
